newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African stocks close weak after volatile trade.
newsitem.headline: S.African stocks close weak after volatile trade.

text.p: 1415 GMT - South African shares ended weak after a volatile day with industrials see-sawing on futures trade and unit trust close-out. Golds ended easier on a softer bullion price.

Dealers said gold shares held up well despite pressure from the weak gold price. They said fund managers appeared satisfied with the market prices ahead of the unit trust close-out on Monday. The market was seen firm on Monday.
Overall index down 1.4 points to 6,933.1, industrials down 14.3 points to 8,179.2 and golds shed 18.1 points to 1,697.
Anglo up 325 cents to 280.50 rand, Vaal Reefs dropped 800 cents to 380 rand.
